label: MRI of the knee (no contrast)
synonyms: knee mri, mri knee, knee scan, mri of knee joint, lower extremity joint mri, torn meniscus scan, acl mri
plain_explanation: A magnetic scan of a knee (or other leg joint) without dye. Common for sports injuries and knee pain.

label: MRI of the brain (no contrast)
synonyms: brain mri, head mri, mri head, mri brain without contrast, headache scan
plain_explanation: A magnetic scan of the brain without dye.

label: MRI of the brain (with and without contrast)
synonyms: brain mri with contrast, mri brain with dye, head mri with contrast, ms scan, tumor scan brain
plain_explanation: A brain MRI taken before and after an injected dye, used when doctors need more detail.

label: CT scan of abdomen and pelvis (with contrast)
synonyms: ct abdomen, ct scan belly, abdominal ct, ct pelvis, cat scan stomach, appendicitis scan, ct with contrast
plain_explanation: A CT (CAT) scan of the belly and pelvis with dye, often for abdominal pain.

label: Chest X-ray (2 views)
synonyms: chest xray, chest x-ray, lung xray, pneumonia xray, cxr
plain_explanation: A standard two-picture X-ray of the chest.

label: Abdominal ultrasound (complete)
synonyms: abdominal ultrasound, belly ultrasound, gallbladder ultrasound, liver ultrasound, sonogram abdomen
plain_explanation: A sound-wave scan of the organs in the belly, like the liver and gallbladder.

label: Screening mammogram
synonyms: mammogram, breast screening, breast cancer screening, mammo
plain_explanation: A routine X-ray of both breasts to screen for cancer.

label: Colonoscopy (diagnostic)
synonyms: colonoscopy, colon scope, colon cancer screening, scope of colon
plain_explanation: A camera exam of the large intestine. Screening colonoscopies are often free under insurance; diagnostic ones may not be.

label: Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy
synonyms: endoscopy, upper endoscopy, egd, stomach scope, scope with biopsy, acid reflux scope
plain_explanation: A camera down the throat to look at the esophagus and stomach, with a small tissue sample.

label: Cataract surgery
synonyms: cataract surgery, cataract removal, lens replacement, eye surgery cataract
plain_explanation: Removing a cloudy eye lens and replacing it with an artificial one.

label: Total knee replacement
synonyms: knee replacement, total knee, tka, knee arthroplasty, new knee
plain_explanation: Surgery that replaces a damaged knee joint. Hospital charge only; surgeon and anesthesia are usually billed separately.

label: Vaginal delivery (routine care)
synonyms: childbirth, giving birth, vaginal birth, having a baby, labor and delivery, normal delivery
plain_explanation: Routine prenatal care, a vaginal delivery, and postpartum care, as billed by the physician code.

label: C-section (routine care)
synonyms: c-section, c section, cesarean, caesarean, cesarean delivery
plain_explanation: Routine prenatal care, a cesarean delivery, and postpartum care.

label: New patient office visit (30-44 min)
synonyms: new patient visit, doctor visit new, first appointment, office visit new patient
plain_explanation: A first visit with a doctor at the hospital's clinic, moderate length.

label: Established patient office visit (20-29 min)
synonyms: doctor visit, follow up visit, office visit, checkup visit, returning patient
plain_explanation: A routine follow-up visit with a doctor you have seen before.

label: ER visit (moderate)
synonyms: er visit, emergency room visit, emergency visit level 3, urgent er
plain_explanation: An emergency room visit of moderate complexity (level 3 of 5). Tests and imaging are billed on top.

label: ER visit (moderately high)
synonyms: er visit level 4, emergency room level 4, serious er visit
plain_explanation: An emergency room visit of moderately high complexity (level 4 of 5).

label: ER visit (high severity)
synonyms: er visit level 5, emergency room severe, critical er visit, highest level er
plain_explanation: The most complex emergency room visit level (5 of 5).

label: Complete blood count (CBC)
synonyms: cbc, blood count, complete blood count, blood test basic
plain_explanation: A basic blood test counting red cells, white cells and platelets.

label: Comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP)
synonyms: cmp, metabolic panel, chem panel, blood chemistry, kidney liver blood test
plain_explanation: A blood test of kidney and liver function, blood sugar and electrolytes.

label: Lipid panel
synonyms: lipid panel, cholesterol test, cholesterol panel, triglycerides test
plain_explanation: A blood test for cholesterol and triglycerides.

label: Physical therapy evaluation
synonyms: pt eval, physical therapy evaluation, physio assessment, physical therapy first visit
plain_explanation: A first physical therapy visit to assess your condition and plan treatment.

label: Sleep study (in lab)
synonyms: sleep study, sleep apnea test, polysomnography, overnight sleep test
plain_explanation: An overnight sleep test in a lab, often for sleep apnea.
